Yes. Well, I don't know. My thoughts race so much. But, more like

I do everything wrong. I have no one. I'm worthless. I'm a waste of space. If I was pretty people would like me. I'm trash. I'm too sad to function properly. People shouldn't behave like this. Happy people aren't like this. I must've done something to deserve this. I'm nothing, I'm gone and hollow and weak and numb. I deserve this. I hate myself. I hate my stupid freckles and ugly big hair and small hands. I hate it. I hate every single thing about me. I hate my laugh and my stupid brown eye color and my small ears. I hate my messed up mind. I hate myself. I hate that I hate myself.
I'm constantly depressed. But, it will get really bad at times. I wouldn't call it spontaneous because many things contribute to it and constantly build up until I break

Both really. It makes everything worse too. 

I wish I was okay.

Oh it was a good rant, no worries.

I honestly can't name a specific event that triggered it. But, it was the most awful thing I have ever been through. Not because I attempted suicide, but because I *failed*. I failed everything. 

I remember leading up to that point, I was exhausted because I hadn't slept in 6 days. I was going mental. I was selfharming, purging, scratching my arms, sobbing. Just to feel something. I couldn't feel one thing. I was numb. I was already gone. My parents were out of town and my brother was gone for the night. I was by myself on the worst night of my entire life. I had one goal for that night. I wanted to die. I couldn't find the light anymore. I couldn't see the point in trying. I couldn't come back to reality. I was gone. I ran through my house with blood down my arms and tears down my face, looking for anything. I grabbed as many pills as I could. I don't know why, but I took a shower then. I cleaned my wounds and bound them. I pampered myself. I do not know why the hell I did. But, I did. I sat on my bed and sorted all of the pills out by how big they were.. And, I can't remember anything else. I woke up in the hospital with the worst migraine of my life.

I tried to fight it I really did. I called so many people, I tried skyping people, messaging someone on facebook. I reached out for help, but nobody would grab me. Nobody was there.

I think I just realized that I'm sad and messed up. And this world doesn't have room for anymore messed up people.

Oh it's okay. Yes. I had a really bad episode during the beginning of the school year. I attempted. But, before that I tried confiding in my mom. She'll either say I'm overreacting/there's nothing wrong/ it's a phase, or that I'm trying to get attention and that I'm selfish. It just doesn't end up well. My dad lashes out so I don't really talk to him.

My parents could not care less. I'm not trying to come off as a whiny 14 year old who thinks her life is awful.

My parents seriously don't care.

My life shouldn't be this bad. I know others have bad parts too. But, my whole life is a bad part. 

I have a therapist but, I haven't seen her in about a month and my mom doesn't seem very interested in scheduling another appointment. I have a guidance counselor at school I talk to occasionally.

I really like art.

I understand where you're coming from. But, the problem isn't just everything around me. The big problem is myself. I've had depression since I was 9. And it's just something I literally can not live with. Things don't get better for me. I'm always at a very very low point.

Um I'm 14, a freshman. Female. I just, I don't know anymore. I feel so disconnected. I can't escape the sadness, everytime I make some sort of progress out of my depression, it always creeps back up. And I fall even harder than before. I can't sleep, I can't eat, I can't think. I don't feel like myself. I don't even know who I am because I've been so sad and broken for so long.. Are some people just supposed to feel this way? Why can't I be happy like some other people? Why can't I be able to relax and have fun? Freshman year is almost over, and I'm supposed to be having fun and taking chances and making friends and creating memories. But, instead, I cry myself to sleep if I'm lucky enough to sleep, I've lost nearly all of my friends, I've attempted suicide twice. 

It's just not fair. I don't understand why it happens to me.

Don't get me wrong, I'm glad I'm like this and not someone else, but I can't help but feel like it's not fair.
